intro._text:
Every component of the StateUI library, **97** in all, each with a live example. Pick a category in the menu, or one of the cards below.

This showcase is an ordinary app of parts: open it with `ui_get` to see how each example is built, or copy a node into your own app. Switch the theme in the header to see every component in another preset.

layout._subtitle: Boxes, rows, folding sections and whole page frames that hold other components.

navigation._subtitle: Menus, tabs, trails and steps that move the user between screens and views.

forms._subtitle: Buttons, fields and whole forms that collect, check and submit what the user enters.

data._subtitle: Tables, lists, charts, boards and calendars over the records of a dataset.

feedback._subtitle: Messages, statuses and placeholders that tell the user what is happening.

overlays._subtitle: Dialogs, drawers, popovers and tooltips that open above the page.

content._subtitle: Text, pictures, icons and surfaces that show content.

conversation._subtitle: Chat screens and message lists that stay at the newest message.

graphics._subtitle: Vector drawings of shapes and WebGL 3D scenes, themed and linkable to data.

root._description: Boxes, rows, folding sections and whole page frames that hold other components. 8 components.

panel._subtitle: Flat box; bordered or elevation raised makes a card; padding none for a layout-only box; header, actions, collapse

toolbar._subtitle: A row of controls laid out by the toolbar itself, with alignment and optional wrapping

accordion._subtitle: A stack of disclosures with one or many open: an FAQ or a settings list

answer._text: Orders leave our warehouse within two working days and arrive two to four days later.
Yes, within 30 days, as long as it is unused and in its box.

payment._title: Which payment methods do you take?

answer._text: Cards, bank transfer and invoices for business accounts.

disclosure._subtitle: A titled section that opens and closes, with a summary while closed and an actions slot: hide advanced settings

splitPane._subtitle: Two panes with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider that can fold the start pane away; stacks on narrow screens

body._text: Revenue grew by 12% this quarter. Drag the divider to give this pane more room, or fold the inbox away.

page._subtitle: The root of an application: header, navigation, main content and footer; the nav collapses on narrow pages

body._text: A page is the root of an app: a header, navigation, the main content and a footer. This showcase itself is a page with a side menu.

dashboardGrid._subtitle: A grid of headline figures and charts that stacks into one column on a phone

settingsPage._subtitle: A settings screen: a side menu of sections and a form for the chosen section

root._description: Menus, tabs, trails and steps that move the user between screens and views. 9 components.

nav._subtitle: The application navigation: menu items with an active one, header and footer slots; overflow scroll keeps one row

menuItem._subtitle: One entry of a menu or navigation: an icon, a label, a description and a shortcut hint

menu._subtitle: A popup list of menu items that a trigger opens, closed by Escape, an outside press or a choice

tabs._subtitle: Children shown one at a time under tabs whose label, icon and badge come from each child's placement

text._text: A summary of the project: three open tasks and one release this month.
Grace moved "Review the date picker" to In progress.

breadcrumb._subtitle: A breadcrumb trail of where the user is: links to the levels above, the current page, the middle collapsed into a menu

link._subtitle: A text-styled link for in-application navigation; it raises press, and shows its screen when it names one

pagination._subtitle: Page buttons for server-paged data: first, last, pages around the current one, previous, next, page size

stepper._subtitle: A step indicator for multi-step flows: numbered or checked steps, with later steps blocked while linear

outlet._subtitle: Where the screens of an app show: the shell holds one; the visible screen appears in it and gets focus on navigation

text._text: The outlet is where the screens of an app show. The shell of this showcase holds one: every screen you open from the menu, this one too, appears in it.

home._text: Open another screen in the outlet

root._description: Buttons, fields and whole forms that collect, check and submit what the user enters. 25 components.

button._subtitle: The actionable atom: a labelled button with an optional icon, five variants and a busy state

form._subtitle: A form that finds its fields, validates them together, and submits, resets and commits their values

textField._subtitle: A labelled single-line text field with optional icon, help and error text

textareaField._subtitle: A labelled multi-line text field that can grow with its text, with help and error text

numberField._subtitle: A labelled number field that reads and shows its value in the locale, with min, max, step and plus and minus buttons

selectField._subtitle: A labelled dropdown of options from data or a translated static map, single or multiple, with help and error text

comboboxField._subtitle: A labelled searchable select: type to filter or search options, pick one, or keep typed text as the value

multiSelectField._subtitle: A labelled field whose value is a list: chosen options show as removable chips, a combobox adds more, optional tag mode

radioField._subtitle: A labelled radio group of options from data or a translated static map, vertical or horizontal, with help and error text

checkField._subtitle: A labelled checkbox that validates and resets like every other field

terms._label: I accept the terms of service

news._help: One email a month, no more

switchField._subtitle: A labelled on and off switch that validates and resets like every other field

sliderField._subtitle: A labelled slider for a number or, with range, a low and high pair, with step, marks and a formatted value

dateField._subtitle: A labelled date field that writes an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), with optional earliest and latest dates

dateRangeField._subtitle: A labelled field for a start and end date: typed dates read with the locale, and a two-month calendar to pick a range

fileField._subtitle: A labelled field that takes files by picker or drop and keeps their references, with progress, remove and cancel

example._help: Pictures or PDFs, up to 10 MB each

paintField._subtitle: A labelled field to paint with brush, eraser, shapes and fill, with undo, redo and clear; the value is a PNG file

searchBox._subtitle: A search input with a search icon and a clear button, for filtering lists

segmented._subtitle: A row of exclusive (radio group) or toggled (toggle buttons) options with optional icons and an icon-only mode

input._subtitle: A bare single-line input with no visible label, for toolbars and table cells

textarea._subtitle: A bare multi-line text area with no visible label, optionally growing with its text

select._subtitle: A bare dropdown of options from data or a translated static map, single or multiple, with no visible label

checkbox._subtitle: A bare checkbox with no visible label

label._text: A bare checkbox, as in a table row

switch._subtitle: A bare on and off switch with no visible label

formDialog._subtitle: A dialog holding a form, with save and cancel, that closes when the form is submitted

wizard._subtitle: A step-by-step flow: a stepper above one screen of questions at a time, with back and next

root._description: Tables, lists, charts, boards and calendars over the records of a dataset. 13 components.

table._subtitle: A table over a list of records: keyed columns, a fixed header, a virtual body, sortable columns and row selection

chart._subtitle: SVG or canvas bar, line, area or donut chart over records; fractionDigits fixes decimals (0 drops currency cents)

stat._subtitle: A headline number with a label, a unit and a trend, formatted for the locale; tone colours the change only

list._subtitle: A list of records drawn through recordList, with an empty state, selection, a current record and sorting

descriptionList._subtitle: Read-only term and value pairs for one record, as a description list

board._subtitle: A kanban board: a column per value of a record field, each a recordList of cards that move by pointer and keyboard

calendar._subtitle: A calendar of records: month, week and day views, arrow-key navigation and a range event for data providers

tree._subtitle: Hierarchical records drawn through recordList: keyed by parent or children, expandable, indented by level

recordList._subtitle: Draws only the visible records of a long list through a small pool of recycled row nodes

recordGrid._subtitle: Draws only the visible records as a grid of cards through a small pool of recycled item nodes

tableRow._subtitle: One row of a table: the cells the table builds from its columns for each visible record

crudTable._subtitle: A table of records with search, add, edit and delete around it

masterDetail._subtitle: A list of records beside the details of the one that is picked; stacks on a phone

root._description: Messages, statuses and placeholders that tell the user what is happening. 8 components.

alert._subtitle: An inline message with a tone, an icon, an optional title and actions, which the user can dismiss

info._text: The service is read-only on Sunday from 02:00 to 04:00.

badge._subtitle: A small status label or count, as a soft, solid, outline or ghost pill, or a dot

progress._subtitle: A bar that shows how far a task has got, or that it is running with no known end

spinner._subtitle: A turning ring that shows work in progress; it stops under reduced motion

skeleton._subtitle: A placeholder block that stands in for text, a picture or an avatar while data loads

emptyState._subtitle: What a list, table or page shows when it has no content: an icon, a title, a text and actions

example._text: Projects you create or join show here.

toast._subtitle: A transient message with a tone, an icon, a title, a text and an optional action, which the user can dismiss

offline._text: Changes will sync when you are back.

toastRegion._subtitle: Toasts shown from named messages with one command, stacked at a corner, with a queue beyond max

text._text: The shell of this showcase has a toast region at the bottom corner. Each button shows one of its named messages.

root._description: Dialogs, drawers, popovers and tooltips that open above the page. 5 components.

modal._subtitle: A modal dialog on a native dialog element, with header, body and footer slots, that keeps its content while closed

text._text: They get an email with a link that is valid for seven days.

drawer._subtitle: A panel that slides in from an edge on a native dialog element, with header, body and footer slots

popover._subtitle: A general anchored panel with a trigger and a body: filters, quick edits and info cards

tooltip._subtitle: A short text label shown next to another node on hover and keyboard focus

copy._text: Copy the link to this page

help._text: Shown on hover and on keyboard focus

confirmDialog._subtitle: A small dialog that asks the user to confirm or cancel before an action goes ahead

body._text: Moonshot and its 14 tasks will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

root._description: Text, pictures, icons and surfaces that show content. 7 components.

text._subtitle: Text in a typographic role, as a span, a paragraph or a heading

body._text: Body text for paragraphs. Each text has a typographic role; the theme sets its size and family.

caption._text: A caption in the accent tone

markdown._subtitle: Formatted text from Markdown source, rendered safely with the theme typography: no HTML, and links that only raise press

example._text:
### Release notes

This release adds **3D scenes** and a *component showcase*.

- Tables keep their header while you scroll
- Charts format currency without cents

> Run `npm run showcase:build` after adding a component.

card._subtitle: A surface with media, header, body and footer slots; interactive raises press; loading shows skeletons

media._alt: Green hills under a dusk sky

text._text: A quiet cottage with a view of the valley.

image._subtitle: A picture from an https URL or inline data, with a fit, an aspect ratio and a corner radius, on the image.fill backdrop

example._alt: Green hills under a dusk sky

avatar._subtitle: A person marker: a picture when there is one, otherwise the initials of the name

icon._subtitle: A named icon drawn from path data: outline or filled, in a tone and a size

divider._subtitle: A separating line, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label in the line

before._text: Sign in with your email address

root._description: Chat screens and message lists that stay at the newest message. 2 components.

messageList._subtitle: A conversation: messages of measured heights in one column that stays at the newest message, with a button back to it

chatView._subtitle: A chat screen: the conversation above and a composer to write and send the next message

root._description: Vector drawings of shapes and WebGL 3D scenes, themed and linkable to data. 20 components.

drawing._subtitle: A vector or canvas drawing of shape nodes (rect, circle, path, drawText...) with theme colours and gradients

example._description: A drawing made of every 2D shape: a gradient sky, stars from a dataset, mountains, a hill, a lake, a road, a house you can drag and a postcard

house._label: The house: drag it along the hill

scene3d._subtitle: A WebGL 3D scene of camera, light, mesh, model, label3d, group3d and repeat3d nodes, checked in a screenshot

example._description: A floor, a group of shapes that bobs, a turning torus, four bars from a dataset, a label and a model file; turn it with the pointer
example._fallback: This 3D scene cannot be shown in this browser: it has a floor, a few shapes, four bars and a model.

model._label: A textured box from a GLB file

rect._subtitle: A rectangle in a drawing, with optional rounded corners

circle._subtitle: A circle in a drawing, by centre and radius

ellipse._subtitle: An ellipse in a drawing, by centre and two radii

line._subtitle: A straight line in a drawing between two [x, y] points

polyline._subtitle: An open line through a list of [x, y] points in a drawing

polygon._subtitle: A closed shape through a list of [x, y] points in a drawing

path._subtitle: Any outline in a drawing from SVG path data (d), parsed and checked, never inserted as markup

drawText._subtitle: A text label placed in a drawing at x, y, with anchor and baseline

drawImage._subtitle: A picture placed in a drawing from a data: URL or an uploaded file

example._title: A picture placed in a drawing

example._title: One circle per record of a dataset
